audit.why: Win rate 53.17% over 2035 games matches packet.
Lane difficulty framing (win early, lose to full evolution) is accurate; Viktor is a weak early laner and out-scales.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart shows Skill on all seven rows while content win[] and packet levelChart both say Naafiri levels 1 through first item and Viktor at 2+ items.
audit.why: Content and packet agree; full layer carries a blanket Skill template. Flipped sides, ratings and whys as an atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Death Ray' and 'Chaos Storm' are fabricated/old names — the kit names are Hextech Ray (E) and Arcane Storm (R). Gravity Field is W, not E, but content tagged it (E) twice. Gravity Field is a zone that stuns after lingering, not a channel.
audit.why: Kit file is authority on names and slots.
audit.corrected: Hextech Ray (E), Arcane Storm (R), Gravity Field (W).

audit.why: Lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT; kit gives Gravity Field 17-13s, Naafiri E 11-7s, Viktor R 120/100/80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing interaction: Viktor's Siphon Power (Q) is an auto-attack reset — the empowered-auto wind-up is the burst tell.

edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Check it before every step-up. - E Eviscerate is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Viktor Gravity Field (W): 17s at rank 1, 13s max — the stun zone owns every all-in, so fight in the long window it is down. - Your E (11s rank 1, 7s max) is the lifeline; never commit without it. - His Arcane Storm runs 120s early — it answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Q the bleed, Q the consume, E through with the pack piling — a six-body trade he answered with one rotation.
edits.after: First Q bleeds, second consumes for bonus damage and sends the pack — take it whenever he steps up to last-hit.

edits.before: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: Pushed past the river line you eat Hextech Ray poke and ganks set up by Gravity Field — shove only with river vision.

edits.before: Trade behind the screen and bleed the contacts — your early strings out-stat most of the lane's expectations.
edits.after: Trade behind the minions and bleed the contacts — his Siphon Power auto-reset wind-up is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Viktor wins by landing Gravity Field, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Viktor wins by surviving to his upgrades — Gravity Field stuns your dive, Hextech Ray farms from range, time does the rest.

edits.before: You are the flank with a head count: R the approach, W through the front line, and let the hounds peel-proof the exit.
edits.after: Evolved Viktor kites the pack: flank from fog, W onto him before Gravity Field lands, and exit with E before the storm turns.

edits.before: Viktor is weak until his Q upgrade, so levels 3-5 are your window to shove him in and W-Q every time he walks up to farm. His only peel is Gravity Field (E slow into stun) which needs channel time, so dash in before it locks and your Packmates burst him down. Deny his Hex Core upgrades by keeping him under tower and behind on CS.
edits.after: Viktor is weak until his Q upgrade, so levels 3-5 are your window to shove him in and W-Q every time he walks up to farm. His only peel is Gravity Field (W, slow into stun) which needs time to lock, so dash in before the stun arms and your Packmates burst him down. Deny his Hex Fragment upgrades by keeping him under tower and behind on CS.

edits.before: His R Chaos Storm is a big AoE that reveals and disrupts, but at 6 you still out-duel him because he's squishy and immobile. All-in when his Gravity Field is down and dog-pile him with your ult's extra Packmates and speed.
edits.after: His R Arcane Storm is a big AoE that follows and disrupts, but at 6 you still out-duel him because he's squishy and immobile. All-in when his Gravity Field is down and dog-pile him with your ult's extra Packmates and speed.

edits.before: Fully upgraded Viktor with Storm, empowered Q shields, and Death Ray waveclear out-scales you hard, so the lategame is his. Force objectives and pick him before teamfights, using R speed to reach him, because a farmed Viktor kites your whole pack.
edits.after: Fully upgraded Viktor with Storm, empowered Q shields, and Hextech Ray waveclear out-scales you hard, so the lategame is his. Force objectives and pick him before teamfights, using R speed to reach him, because a farmed Viktor kites your whole pack.

edits.before: Once Viktor finishes his Hex Core evolutions he out-scales you decisively with Chaos Storm, empowered Q, and Death Ray, so you must close the game early and pick him before he can kite the pack.
edits.after: Once Viktor finishes his Hex Fragment evolutions he out-scales you decisively with Arcane Storm, empowered Q, and Hextech Ray, so you must close the game early and pick him before he can kite the pack.
